therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: VEGF trap - binds and neutralizes VEGF ligands
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: previously untreated stage IV colorectal cancer patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: proportion of patients alive and progression-free at 15 months

results.dose_information: aflibercept 4 mg/kg IV every 2 weeks with FOLFOX6 (oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2, leucovorin 200 mg/m2, fluorouracil 400 mg/m2 bolus + 2400 mg/m2 continuous infusion)

context.duration: treatment until progression, follow-up up to 4 years and 2 months
